description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableDictionary class, which is a persistent, journaled dictionary implementation in Orleans. The tests verify basic operations, persistence and recovery, handling of complex key and value types, clearing, and enumeration capabilities.

classes.name: DurableDictionaryTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the DurableDictionary in Orleans, covering CRUD operations, persistence, complex types, clearing, and enumeration.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A custom key type used in tests to verify handling of complex keys in the durable dictionary, marked with GenerateSerializer for Orleans serialization.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic add, update, remove, and indexer access operations on the durable dictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the dictionary's state persists across system restarts by simulating recovery.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexKeys_Test
methods.description: Tests handling of custom complex key objects in the durable dictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Tests handling of custom complex value objects, including updates to nested properties.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Clear_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the clear operation removes all items and is properly journaled.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Checks that the dictionary supports enumeration, Keys, and Values collections.
